PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.Name: Market Forge
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.OpenHint: Open Market Forge for this actor
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.Milestone1ReadOnly: Milestone 1 is read-only: no items or currency are changed yet.
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.Buy.EmptyText: The search and filter surface is in place. The next step indexes selected PF2e compendia and displays their items as expandable market rows.
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.Spells.EmptyText: This area will list spells that can be turned into scrolls and standard wands at a selected rank.
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.Sell.Title: Sell Inventory
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.Sell.Text: The actor used to open Market Forge is already selected as the sale source.
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.Sell.InventoryPendingT: Market Forge can already read the actor. Selection, quantities, pricing, and the sale cart will be connected next.
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.Cart.Title: Cart
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.Cart.Text: Purchase and sale lines are collected and totaled before any transaction is executed.
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.Cart.EmptyText: Milestone 1 already shows the checkout area but intentionally performs no transactions.
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.Settings.ShowInventory: Shows a button in character and party inventory tabs that opens Market Forge.
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.Settings.ShowActorCont: Adds an Open Market Forge context entry for usable character and party actors.
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.Errors.PF2EOnly: PF2E Market Forge can only be used with the Pathfinder 2e system.
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.Errors.NoActor: No suitable character or party actor is available for Market Forge.
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.Errors.PermissionDenie: You do not have permission to use Market Forge for this actor.
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.Milestone2ReadOnly: Milestone 2 remains read-only: the catalog and previews are active, but the cart and transactions do not change items or currency yet.
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.Milestone2CartHint: The cart becomes active in Milestone 3.
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.Buy.NoResultsText: No items match the current search and market filters.
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.Availability.rarity-no: Rarity is not available on this market
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.Availability.source-no: Compendium is not allowed for this market
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.Errors.ItemOpenFailed: The item sheet could not be opened.
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.Cart.TextM3: Purchase lines are collected, totaled together, and fully revalidated before a future real checkout.
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.Cart.InsufficientFunds: There is currently not enough currency for this purchase.
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.Cart.DryRunHint: The dry run recalculates availability, prices, and funds. It creates no items and removes no currency.
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.Cart.ValidationError: Purchase validation could not be completed
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.Cart.EmptyTextM3: Add items from the Buy tab. Identical products are merged automatically.
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.Milestone3ReadOnly: Milestone 3 only performs a checkout dry run: cart and price validation are active, while inventories and currency remain unchanged.
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.Errors.ItemUnavailable: This item is not available on the current market.
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.TransactionError.item-: At least one item is no longer available.
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.TransactionError.inval: At least one item has an invalid price.
The currency balance could not be read as a valid amount.
At least one quantity is invalid.
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.TransactionError.empty: The cart contains no lines to validate.
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.Cart.TextM4: Purchase lines are collected, totaled together, and fully revalidated immediately before checkout writes any documents.
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.Cart.CheckoutHintM4: Checkout revalidates availability, prices, permissions, and funds. Only then are currency and items changed.
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.Cart.PurchaseRolledBac: Purchase failed; all changes were rolled back
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.Cart.RollbackFailed: Critical rollback failure. Please inform the GM.
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.Cart.PurchaseFailedNot: The purchase could not be completed. The cart has been preserved.
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.Cart.RollbackFailedNot: The purchase failed and could not be fully rolled back. Please inform the GM.
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.Cart.EmptyTextM4: Add items from the Buy tab. The cart is cleared automatically after a successful purchase.
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.Milestone4Footer: Milestone 4 performs real purchases: price, availability, permissions, and funds are revalidated immediately before mutation; failures trigger compensating rollback.
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.TransactionError.permi: You do not have permission to modify the inventory or payment source.
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.TransactionError.trans: A Market Forge transaction is already running for this actor.
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.TransactionWarning.rec: The purchase succeeded, but the chat receipt could not be created.
PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.TransactionWarning.rol: The original state could not be restored completely.
